verdict.rationale: Codex is described as an autonomous coding agent that operates on the whole repo without needing manual file selection (codex-gh-1, codex-docs-4/6), implying it can explore and explain code, but no evidence explicitly confirms a 'map and explain unfamiliar codebase' feature, and community feedback highlights inconsistent competence on complex tasks (codex-comm-3, codex-comm-13).
